nodes.label: Canonical Manifest
nodes.rationale: Each responsibility has exactly one canonical file; undeclared duplicate rule/workflow files fail validation.

nodes.label: One Canonical File Per Responsibility
nodes.rationale: Prevents duplicate/conflicting rules or workflows under alternate names.

nodes.label: Post-Setup Validation
nodes.rationale: Setup is complete only when validation passes, no workflow conflicts, safety intact; repairs limited to .ai-engineering Markdown/config.

nodes.label: No Application Code Changes During Setup
nodes.norm_label: no application code changes during setup

nodes.label: Mandatory Activation Areas
nodes.rationale: Maps to Deep task size in CLAUDE.md and docs/ai/risk-register.md.

nodes.label: Embedding Dimension 1536
nodes.rationale: Embedding model change is a schema + reindex event, not a config tweak.

nodes.label: SKIPPED_ALREADY_IMPLEMENTED
nodes.rationale: If every acceptance criterion already has repository evidence, no implementer or PR work is dispatched.

nodes.label: Strict TDD
nodes.rationale: Failing test first, confirm failure, implement until pass, per CLAUDE.md.

nodes.label: Approved Plan File Scope
nodes.rationale: Touch only files listed in approved plan; unlisted file means stop and re-approve.

nodes.label: Workspace Isolation (workspaceId filtering)
nodes.rationale: Cross-workspace leakage is the single worst bug; every tenant query filters by workspaceId.

nodes.label: Project QA Checks
nodes.rationale: Passing tests alone are not QA sign-off.

nodes.label: Project Review Checklist
nodes.rationale: Passing tests alone is not approval.

nodes.label: Approval Gates
nodes.rationale: Production, destructive actions, migrations, auth/permissions, rate limits, deploy, new deps require human approval.

nodes.label: Level 2 Default Autonomy
nodes.rationale: AI implements and creates PRs; merges/deploys stay human.

nodes.label: Human Approval Controls Irreversible Actions
nodes.rationale: AI may prepare work; humans own business decisions and production risk.

nodes.label: Solution Priority Order
nodes.rationale: Correctness > simplicity > maintainability > existing patterns > performance.

nodes.label: Primary Engineering Loop
nodes.rationale: Human Request -> PM -> Architect -> Coordinator -> Implementer -> Reviewer -> QA -> PR -> Human Approval -> Report.

nodes.label: Mandatory Safety Rules
nodes.rationale: Never expose secrets, bypass approvals, modify production, perform destructive actions automatically, or overwrite project instructions.

nodes.label: Canonical Lifecycle States
nodes.rationale: NEW -> TRIAGED -> ANALYZING -> PLANNED -> READY -> BUILDING -> REVIEW -> QA -> PR_READY -> WAITING_APPROVAL -> MERGED -> VERIFIED -> REPORTED.

nodes.label: Instruction Precedence
nodes.rationale: Existing project instructions win; package adds structure, never overwrites. CLAUDE.md authoritative; unresolved equal-authority conflicts are BLOCKED_HUMAN.

nodes.label: Codex Retired Status
nodes.rationale: CLAUDE.md single-agent rule: Claude owns routing, analysis, planning, implementation, validation in one lane; no scratchpad handoff. Rules kept only as canonical package inventory.

nodes.label: Input Output Contract
nodes.rationale: Agent without clear input/output contract must have its definition repaired.

nodes.label: Repair Scope Restriction
nodes.rationale: Fix only Markdown/config inside .ai-engineering/; never weaken checks, safety, or approval rules; never touch app code, infra, secrets.

nodes.label: Smallest Correction
nodes.rationale: Apply smallest correction restoring documented contract; do not delete or weaken checks to pass.

nodes.label: Task Lifecycle State Machine
nodes.rationale: Feature work moves NEW→TRIAGED→ANALYZING→PLANNED→READY→BUILDING→REVIEW→QA→PR_READY→WAITING_APPROVAL→MERGED→VERIFIED→REPORTED; already-implemented work short-circuits to SKIPPED_ALREADY_IMPLEMENTED.

nodes.label: No Automatic Merge
nodes.rationale: No merge or release occurs automatically without required human approval.

nodes.label: Passing Tests Alone Is Not Approval
nodes.norm_label: passing tests alone is not approval

nodes.label: Daily backup workflow
nodes.rationale: Separate from deploy so the DB is protected on days nothing ships; own concurrency group so a deploy never cancels a backup; red run is the only alerting.

nodes.label: BACKUP_S3_* B2 credentials via envs
nodes.rationale: Forwarded as env, never interpolated into script, to avoid leaking into debug logs.

nodes.label: CI and Deploy workflow
nodes.rationale: One workflow so `needs: ci` guarantees main deploys only when the gate passed on that exact commit; workflow_run split would race.

nodes.label: deploy job (deploy-production)
nodes.rationale: Never cancelled mid-flight; up --force-recreate can leave prod half-replaced.

nodes.label: scripts/backup.sh --reason=deploy
nodes.rationale: Rollback point for THIS deploy; tolerates missing postgres on first deploy.

nodes.label: Workspace isolation invariant
nodes.rationale: Cross-workspace leakage is the worst bug; every tenant query filters workspaceId.

nodes.label: Rate limit and token budget invariant
nodes.rationale: Protects LLM cost; new chat/refine/extraction paths must not bypass.
nodes.norm_label: rate limit and token budget invariant

nodes.label: Plan Contract (two-layer plan, Risk + BC matrices)
nodes.norm_label: plan contract (two-layer plan, risk + bc matrices)

nodes.label: Three test layers requirement
nodes.rationale: Owner decision 2026-09-25; unit + API e2e + Playwright; enforced by check-test-layers.sh.

nodes.label: Personal portfolio project status
nodes.rationale: Engineered like prod but no customers/billing; keeps rigor, relaxes public-claim blockers.

nodes.label: mnemra_at / mnemra_rt cookie identifiers
nodes.rationale: Live identifiers kept after Optra rename; renaming logs out every session.

nodes.label: Calm Utility design system

nodes.label: Detect model-generated fallback phrase

nodes.rationale: Navigation docs are maps only; if map conflicts with code, code wins.

nodes.label: Deep Task Defaults
nodes.rationale: Billing, auth, roles, jobs, migrations, infra default to Deep; downgrade only on repo evidence of isolation.

nodes.label: Missing Stored Object
nodes.rationale: A row can point at a key storage no longer has; must be a 404 with reason, never a 500.

nodes.label: Comparison Run Integrity

nodes.label: Decision Audit Trail
nodes.rationale: discrepancy_decisions is append-only by construction.

nodes.label: Timestamps Without Time Zone
nodes.rationale: All timestamp columns lack zone; non-UTC Node process misreads fresh rows.

nodes.label: Reconciler Ownership
nodes.rationale: Each stale-job sweeper must select only rows its own queue owns.

nodes.label: Test/Production Runtime Mismatch
nodes.rationale: Prod runs API on Bun while tests run on Node.

nodes.label: Required Test Layers
nodes.rationale: Owner decision 2026-09-25: unit + API e2e + Playwright for every layer a change touches; happy and error paths.

nodes.label: scripts/check-test-layers.sh
nodes.rationale: CI guard enforcing sibling specs per commit; Test-Layers-Skip trailer allowed but never silent.

nodes.label: playwright.prod.config.ts
nodes.rationale: Separate config so local suite never runs smoke; refuses non-https base URL.

nodes.label: Smoke Purchase Order Leftover
nodes.rationale: Procurement documents have no delete, so one smoke-<run>.csv PO remains per run.

nodes.label: Backup Dumps optra-backups
nodes.rationale: Newest seven kept locally, older in B2; objects are not in dumps.

nodes.label: Fresh optra_unit DB Per Run In UTC
nodes.rationale: Unit tests shared the dev DB, so one test's leftovers answered another's question.

nodes.label: TRUST_PROXY X-Forwarded-For Chain
nodes.rationale: API saw only the web server IP; Caddy writes IP, BFF forwards, API trusts one hop.
